transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here today because I've been having a really hard time organizing my daily tasks and activities. I also find myself frequently losing important items that I need to get things done, and it's becoming a major struggle for me.
Do you also find yourself frequently struggling to remain seated in quiet settings, or do you often feel a sense of inner restlessness that makes it difficult to stay still?
No, I don't really experience that. I don't have any trouble staying seated, and I don't feel that kind of inner restlessness at all.
To better understand your history, have these difficulties with organization and losing items been present since you were a child, or did they only begin more recently?

Yes, these difficulties have been going on for a very long time, definitely since I was a child. I can remember struggling with organizing my schoolwork and constantly losing my things well before I turned 12.
